in_marathi.name: Sharvithaadevi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Knowledge and Wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvithaadevi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharvithaadevi is the goddess of knowledge and wisdom in Hinduism. She is often depicted with multiple heads and multiple arms, holding various symbols of learning and knowledge.
